why_it_passes: installs a named GitHub App on the person's own account for one named repository; nothing to choose; gh reads the installation

input.title: Let our test runner see your notes repository
input.brief:
1. In the browser where you are signed in to GitHub as bea-gh, open https://github.com/apps/example-runner/installations/new
2. Pick the account bea-gh.
3. Choose Only select repositories and select bea-gh/notes only.
4. Press Install.
5. Confirm the page then shows example-runner under Installed GitHub Apps.
